rule: Any Question whose id appears in question_group_items.question_id is an internal group child and must be excluded from every automated/student-facing standalone Question selector, regardless of group/child status.
administrative_exception: Staff Question Bank CRUD/list/get may still expose child rows for review and maintenance.
shared_helper: Implement one reusable SQLAlchemy predicate/helper, e.g. standalone_question_only(), rather than duplicating ad-hoc subqueries.
required_outcome: Even if all 152 child rows are APPROVED in a future release, no child can be selected as an independent practice/recommendation/assignment/diagnostic/repair/exam question.
